description: Rank past merged PRs as precedents for a new task (asked per candidate after a keyword prefilter over the commit log). A ranked hint, never a gate.
instructions: Is this past change a useful precedent for the new request (the same behavior, component or failure handled before): {item}?
output: Pre-read hint line: past merged PRs worth opening, at most three.
evidence: Unmeasured: too few PRs cite an earlier PR to score recall. Shown as an unverified hint (p at least 0.5, at most 3).
